class_label: academic gown, academic robe, judge's robe
focus_areas: Hand anatomy and finger separation (structural collapse)
Boundary sharpness between hands and gown sleeves
Text legibility on the diploma cover
Geometric drape and silhouette of the visible upper gown
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands. AI generators frequently fail at rendering hands inside or near complex sleeves. Verify if the fingers are physically plausible or if they merge with the black fabric. Also, check if the diploma looks like a real object or a painted approximation, specifically looking for gibberish text. Ensure the visible upper body geometry of the gown follows a realistic rectangular drape.
image_description: Two women standing side-by-side wearing black academic regalia (gowns and mortarboard caps). The woman on the left holds a white diploma cover. Both subjects are smiling. The gowns appear to be standard bachelor's or master's style with wide sleeves.
